name: Messenger
short_desc: Encrypted text conversations with your peers, inside Wizard.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Private two-person messaging with dedicated contact addresses and local encrypted history. Runs in its own isolated container with a documented API and customizable Wizard-themed view. This is a local candidate; repository/image publication remains pending. Initial setup creates a separate Messenger identity; after a restart, unlock with your passphrase. Groups, media, calls and phone push follow later.

form_fields.label: Integration capability
form_fields.hint: Your Wizard generates this application-only capability. Use at least 32 characters; it is never pasted into the Messenger screen.

form_fields.label: Wizard web address
form_fields.hint: Your Wizard fills its own private HTTPS address, without a trailing slash. Browser writes are restricted to this exact origin.

form_fields.label: App path
form_fields.hint: The standard Wizard app path. Keep the trailing slash.
